title: Keep monitoring interruption confirmation stable during artifact-refusal diagnostics
outcome: A saved operator monitoring interruption on an unassociated provider row is not reported as failed solely because a bounded artifact diagnostic changes.
acceptance: A deterministic behavioral interleaving persists an operator monitoring interruption, writes or discards an artifact-association diagnostic during its off-lock durability wait, and confirms the intended interruption without a spurious superseded or HTTP 409 result.
Original observation identity, real durability and completion/receipt/credit custody guards remain intact; an idempotent retry and a genuinely changed observation remain covered.
